summary: Both inherited halves are falsified on file-scoped fixtures via the real parseSpec: deleting '## Overview' and putting '## Requirements' before '## Overview' each raise REQ-001.1.2, while a prose-only Requirements section, a missing Requirements heading, and a well-formed '### 1: Outside' heading placed under Overview (sections==[] , not smuggled in) each raise REQ-001.1.3.
